project.description: Packages the MCP service image from the per-stack reactor lane and ships the tarball to the stack's S3 prefix. Requires a prior successful 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' for the same TARGET_STACK. When that build's pic-sure ref predates the MCP module, the job logs that and succeeds without building an image.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build - ${TARGET_STACK}" MODULE="services/pic-sure-mcp" STAMP="$MAVEN_WS/build-info/$(printf '%s' "$MODULE" | tr '/' '_').txt"
if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/$MODULE/pom.xml" ]; then echo "The pic-sure ref checked out for stack ${TARGET_STACK} has no $MODULE module, so any jar or stamp left in that directory is from an earlier build. Skipping the pic-sure-mcp image." exit 0 fi
if [ ! -f "$STAMP" ] || ! ls "$MAVEN_WS/$MODULE"/target/pic-sure-mcp-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no current artifacts for $MODULE on stack ${TARGET_STACK}. Run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' with MODULES=$MODULE first." exit 2 fi . "$STAMP"
docker build --load \ -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-mcp:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-mcp/"
docker save "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-mcp:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" | gzip > pic-sure-mcp.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp pic-sure-mcp.tar.gz "s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$TARGET_STACK/containers/pic-sure-mcp.tar.gz"
